items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: And three or four was in the band... I used to sit back of him all the time to keep him from going to sleep... I'd get him at the wheel and drive.

ctx.x: I looked down, and I saw it was about two city blocks down below us, the railroad track, Mm-hmm. Way down there. And King Alva was sitting. He always sat on the front, right seat. Mm-hmm. And when that bus did that, he got his back hurt. And I don't think he ever got better from that. Yeah. And three or four was in the band, because everybody wanted to get out of, try to jump out of the bus, you know. Mm-hmm. And I was sitting, I had, um, something with my, uh, my foot, like, uh, it was like, like, uh, something…
